From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-call recap + proposed activation canvas for NimbleHealth POC

Thanks again for the call today — appreciate the clarity on what success looks like for the trial. I captured the essentials below and proposed owners so we can move quickly into a short activation sprint. Please review and flag anything I missed.

Summary of agreed evaluation goals (success criteria)
- 95th percentile inference latency <= 200ms for 512-token requests under 10 RPS
- Model output fidelity: top-line intent match >= 92% vs your in-house testset
- Max monthly spend target for the two-week trial: $3,000 (goal, not exceed without approval)

Evaluation plan & timeline (high level)
1) Week 0 (this week): exchange infra details + access (Nimble provides VPC peering info and KMS contact)
2) Week 1: Redwood deployment into customer VPC (private control-plane) + smoke tests
3) Week 2: Load run with your sample dataset, collect latency/cost/quality metrics
4) End of Week 2: short readout + decision (extend / optimize / stop)

Ownership (proposed — please confirm)
- Customer (NimbleHealth): app owner and data steward (owns sample data, network, firewall rules, KMS keys). Primary contact: Emma Huang (you) + Procure team for contractual items.
- Redwood (Rishi, Ben): runtime deployment, model configuration, telemetry, and trial metric dashboard. Technical lead: Ben Carter.
- Integration contractor (optional): Sam Torres — assist with VPC networking if there are routing quirks.
- Procurement & Commercial: Kimberly Park to lead contract/PO and commercial terms.

Open questions / quick asks for NimbleHealth
- Confirm which environment we should deploy to (staging vs. dedicated trial VPC) and provide VPC peering CIDR and admin contact.
- Share the minimal sample dataset (s3 link or sharepoint) and a 10–20 prompt seed list for fidelity checks.
- Any compliance artifacts we should pre-share before deployment? You mentioned SOC2 in the call.

Attachments: nimble_poc_requirements.xlsx (worksheet: success-criteria + infra checklist) and a draft SOW I will send to Kimberly once we get the procurement contact.

Next steps (action owners)
- Emma: reply with procurement contact and VPC details (by EOD Thu)
- Ben: will draft deployment checklist and runbook (internal)
- PrIyom: set up a lightweight monitoring dashboard and share read-only link
- Kimberly: once cc'd, help surface standard T&Cs / PO cadence

Happy to jump on a 20–30m follow-up if that helps.

--
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
